subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this custom yielding glob walker and bootstrap-only handler scheduling as the bounded fix for the linked event-loop stall, given the remaining extra-bootstrap compatibility and session-timing risk?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well-proven, but automation cannot safely decide whether the responsiveness gain warrants replacing dependency-owned traversal semantics and introducing inter-handler event-loop interleaving on a compatibility-sensitive prompt/session path.

options.title: Land After Exact-Head Verification
options.body: Accept the bounded implementation and merge after the current head is refreshed against main and all required exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Split Hook Scheduling
options.body: Land the asynchronous file and glob work first, but defer yielding between hook handlers if maintainers want a smaller session-scheduling change.

options.title: Pause For Runtime Architecture
options.body: Keep or close this PR if maintainers prefer worker isolation, priority scheduling, or another broader design instead of owning a custom traversal implementation.

recommendation.title: Land After Exact-Head Verification
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded implementation and merge after the current head is refreshed against main and all required exact-head gates pass.
